definitions: A public statement or action showing support of something or someone.
A signature on a document, such as a cheque, to make it valid.
A note on a driving licence recording a motoring offence.
The act of promoting a product in an advertisement.
examples: The candidate received a celebrity endorsement.
The cheque requires an endorsement on the back.
He has a speeding endorsement on his licence.
The athlete signed a multi-million pound endorsement deal.
